slices.title: Picker search and list price at /v1/models
slices.summary: Adds a type-to-search field to both model pickers (shared filterModels, shown only above 6 chat models) and, with the switch on, an optional price sibling (input/output per million, currency, source exact|prefix) on each /v1/models entry. Prices come from one PricingCache snapshot per request; Default-only, Unavailable and Subscription matches give no price. No proto and no migration; the flag defaults false in compose. Rebase on WS10-S6 picker edits.
test_commands: pnpm exec vitest run src/shared/api src/shared/components src/features/dashboard/home

slices.title: Memory containment completed (Space and agent_run threads)
slices.summary: Adds memory_control::thread_containment(origin, has_space) as the single rule, new MemoryReason values space_scope and agent_run_scope, and makes thread_facts read origin and space_id. Inline extraction, IndexMemory, context assembly and SearchMemory then refuse Space threads (agent_run: reads kept, writes refused), ahead of the controls kill switch; a source-scan test pins the dreaming.rs predicate to the helper. No flag, no migration, no field change (comment-only proto edit); also adds the FE skip-reason string. Test list should add that a scheduled fire reads as the creator and writes none (round A C5).
slices.remaining: Inline append extraction, IndexMemory and recall into Space threads still reach personal and org memory; add the shared containment helper and two reason values, applied before the controls kill switch.
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p session-core --lib memory_control
cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p model-gateway --lib memory_prefetch

session-core DB harness (ignored DB tests with DATABASE_URL): space_turn_creates_no_personal_memory_inline, agent_run_turn_creates_no_memory_inline, index_memory_refuses_in_space_thread_with_space_scope, space_thread_context_assembly_has_no_user_or_org_rows, space_thread_search_memory_returns_skip_reason_space_scope, agent_run_thread_still_recalls_owner_memory, chat_thread_unchanged, the six D1-532 gate tests, space_thread_messages_never_reach_user_memory

decisions_defaults.D1: agent_run threads read the owner's memory but write none (reason agent_run_scope)
decisions_defaults.D2: Space threads read nothing from agent_memory (reason space_scope as skip_reason)
decisions_defaults.D13: Containment is always on and runs before the MEMORY_CONTROLS_ENABLED early return

slices.title: Settled-turn folding
slices.summary: Adds a pure foldPlan/isSettled module and a SettledTurnFold row that shows 'Worked for X - N steps' for settled turns, with approvals, questions, plans, errors and receipts always rendered outside the fold. ChatMessages gets a mount line only (hot file over the size ceiling). Works with virtualisation and paged transcript on or off; default off behind VITE_CHAT_SETTLED_FOLD. No proto or migration.
slices.remaining: Whole slice: fold logic, fold row component, mount line in ChatMessages, tests.
test_commands: cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && pnpm exec vitest run src/features/chat/lib/settled-fold.test.ts src/features/chat/components/SettledTurnFold.test.tsx src/features/chat/components/ChatMessages.plan-gate.test.tsx

decisions_defaults.D7: Fold only a settled turn; never the last turn while a run is active; never hide approval, plan-approval, question, effect receipt, error or ZDR-refusal nodes; duration from user message to terminal frame; one click or Enter unfolds; folded state per view, not stored.
